fusions.name: Inked Mouthful
fusions.desc: Spits ink that deals 8 damage and has a 50% chance to leave the target [Blunted] for 6 seconds. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

fusions.name: Eight-Way Splash
fusions.desc: Looses 8 jets in a wide fan, dealing 2 damage to everything caught in it.

fusions.name: Jet Kick
fusions.desc: A short jetting burst that carries you 5 tiles forward. You move 25% faster for 3 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Arm Reach
fusions.desc: Calls a bonded familiar of water that fights beside you, striking for 4 damage. It also leaves [Poisoned], dealing 2 damage per tick for 4 ticks.
